title: SoftTech Engineers Ltd (NSE: SOFTTECH) — Institutional Investment Dossier
primer: SoftTech Engineers Ltd builds AutoDCR and CivitPERMIT software for over 1,500 Indian cities. FY26 revenue jumped 39.5% to ₹132.90 Cr, and H1 FY27 orders in hand reached ₹302.35 Cr. Yet eight straight years of negative free cash flow, ₹90.22 Cr of capitalized intangibles, and a 2.77% ROE expose weak cash conversion. At ₹425.90 (118.89x TTM P/E) in a Stage 4 downtrend, the verdict is REJECTED.
holding_rationale: Positions ledger as of 2026-11-13 confirms 0 shares held in SOFTTECH. Do not initiate a new position: 118.89x P/E, negative 8-year cumulative FCF, and Stage 4 technical breakdown make risk/reward unfavorable.

holding_alerts.instruction: Do not buy unless SOFTTECH reports 2 consecutive quarters of positive FCF (CFO > all capitalized R&D/capex) and combined receivable + unbilled days fall below 120.
Monitor only if price reclaims ₹455.00 (above 50-DMA ₹451.06 and 30W-SMA ₹431.16) on >2x average volume (8,500+ shares/day) alongside FCF inflection.
A daily close below the 200-DMA (₹387.28) confirms full Stage 4 continuation toward ₹320 Base / ₹225 Bear targets; keep removed from active shortlist.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Next marginal ₹1,00,000 of new-capital allocation under review (SOFTTECH is NOT_HELD).

destinations.rationale: SOFTTECH is REJECTED on Valuation (118.89x P/E), Cash Flow (8 years negative FCF), and Trend (Stage 4). Preserve marginal capital in cash until a dedicated underwriting ticket is executed.
destinations.entry_condition: Hold in liquid cash earning ~6.5%–7.0% yield until deployed into a Stage 2 compounder.

destinations.recommendation: Benchmark Priority on Active Shortlist (Separate Ticket)
destinations.rationale: MANORAMA trades at ₹1,984.10 in confirmed Stage 2 (BUY_AT_CMP_NO_FOMO, CLEAR_FOR_CONSIDERATION) with a ₹2,650.00 base target and 2.12:1 R:R vs ₹1,664.02 stop, offering vastly superior trend and capital efficiency.
destinations.entry_condition: Consider on a dedicated fresh-capital underwriting ticket near ₹1,869.54–₹1,984.10.

destinations.recommendation: Superior Software Peer — Watch for Stage 2 Reclaim
destinations.rationale: NEWGEN (₹439.15) delivers 18.5% TTM ROE and 25.0% ROCE at 19.6x TTM P/E—nearly 7x cheaper than SOFTTECH's 118.89x P/E—though it is currently in Stage 4 below its 50-DMA (₹473.93).
destinations.entry_condition: 0% allocation now; monitor for Stage 2 reclaim above ₹490 on institutional volume.
